notes.title: Regarding an Issue Preventing the First-Time Play Tutorial from Ending
notes.content:
[h2]We have confirmed an issue where the tutorial that starts the first time you play the game
does not end.

[i][list]
[*] Issue in which tutorial that starts when first you play the game does not end.
[/list][/i]
When the tutorial begins after booting up the game for the first time, it keeps going even if the conditions to end it are met.

This issue has been fixed with the patch released today.[/h2]

[h3]We are very sorry for the inconvenience.
We hope you continue to enjoy Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.[/h3]

notes.title: Producer video and Update 1.31
notes.content:
[h2]Help us improve your experience by filling out [url=https://bn-survey.bn-ent.net/Q/auto/en/000000tsubasaronchen/enq1/]this survey[/url]![/h2]

The following updates have been implemented:

[h3]⚽ Displaying Move/Skill Prerequisites[/h3]
Prerequisites for moves/skills in EPISODE: NEW HERO will now be displayed.

[h3]⚽ Custom BGM Functionality[/h3]
BGM played during Versus and Online Versus can now be changed.
Look for custom BGM tracks in shops.

[h3]⚽ New Items Added to the CC Shop[/h3]
"Online-based Player Slot" and "Online-based Team Slot" have been added to the CC Shop.
Please take advantage of this opportunity.

[h3]⚽ Changes to Matchmaking Settings[/h3]
Added "Matchmaking with CPU On/Off" to Online Versus.
Also, "Matchmaking Range" was removed from the Matchmaking Settings.

[h3]⚽ Added Forfeit Functionality[/h3]
It is now possible to forfeit Online Versus matches.

[h3]⚽ Changes to Division Match Costs[/h3]
We have done away with costs based on rating and made the cost 1,600 for all ratings.
Along with this, you can now match with any rating in matchmaking player search from the start.

[h3]⚽ Adjustments to Normal Shots[/h3]
We have made adjustments so that shots made without moves do not exceed a certain level of power.

[h3]⚽ Adjustments to Stacking Skill Effects[/h3]
The following skills have been adjusted so that their effects do not stack when activated by multiple characters.

[Affected skills]
[i]Sunshine Boy/Crushing Blocker/Pressure Monster/For Glory[/i]

[h3]⚽ Added Skip Functionality for Certain Parts of the Prologue[/h3]
You can now keep the Game Guide from reappearing and skip the tutorial during the prologue.

[h3]⚽ Adjustments to Moves/Skills[/h3]
Adjusted the descriptions and effects of some Moves/Skills.

[Affected Moves/Skills]
[i]Pressure Monster/Miracle Assist/Charging Passer/Last Pass/Passing Expert/Pass Master[/i]

[h3]⚽ Fixes to Matchmaking[/h3]
Fixed issue where users were not matched correctly when including
a custom player set with Skylab Triangle w/ Tachibanas in their team.

[h3]⚽ Other[/h3]
Stability improvements have been made.


We hope you continue to enjoy [b]Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions[/b].

[previewyoutube=J0HL6OzHEmU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update Information & New DLC Characters Available for Purchase
notes.content:
[h2]The following updates have been implemented:[/h2]

[h3]Hanawa MS Route[/h3]
Hanawa MS Route for [b]EPISODE: NEW HERO[/b] is now available.

[h3]New Characters Added (Paid DLC)[/h3]
The 3 players [b]Xiao Junguang, Pepe, and Taichi Nakanishi[/b] are now available.
[i]*Purchase them from the store to use them.[/i]

[h3]Online Storage Functionality Added[/h3]
Implemented functionality that allows you to save Custom Players and Custom Teams in online storage.
Eight Custom Player and five Custom Team slots can be used for free.

[i]*We are planning to provide additional slots for purchase in a future update.
*By using the players in WorldStars, the default Custom Team, users who have not unlocked every team will be able to participate in future events.
*If you swap the players in the Custom Team WorldStars with players from any other team,
and have not unlocked every team, you might not be able to participate in events.[/i]

[h3]New Items Added to the CC Shop[/h3]
Five new Hairstyles have been added to the CC Shop.
Please take advantage of this opportunity.

[h3]Balance Changes to Blake Dribble[/h3]
Blake Dribble's effect On Success/Chain Success has been adjusted.

[h3]Balance Changes to Captain Skill Aztec Warrior Counter[/h3]
Stats raised when activating Aztec Warrior Counter were higher than expected, so they have been adjusted.

[h3]Shot Move Cost Changes[/h3]
The cost for some Shot Moves has been adjusted.

[b][Affected Shot Moves][/b]
Razor Shot/☆ Double-Bladed Razor Shot/☆ Falcon Shot/☆ Neo Drive Shot/☆ Miracle Overhead/ ☆ Banana Shot

[h3]Skill Descriptions Updated[/h3]
Some skills have had their descriptions adjusted.
[i]*Actual effects of the skills are unchanged[/i]

[b][Affected Skills][/b]
Fierce Tiger's Tenacity (Attack)/Finishing Touch

[h3]Other[/h3]
Stability improvements have been made.


[h2]Today, we've begun offering 3 popular characters for purchase as part of the 3rd round of paid DLC. They are available in the store. Try 'em out![/h2]

[h3]Xiao Junguang (China/Midfielder)[/h3]
A midfielder who's focused on a powerful counter-shot. With his insanely powerful block move Superspeed Kickback Cannon, if the power of his opponent's shot exceeds a certain level, he can shoot it back with even more power.
Also in his repertoire are Junguang Sliding, an exceedingly fast tackle that is great for defense, as well as Opportunist and Finishing Touch, which allow him to support the offense even from a rear-leaning position such as his.

[h3]Pepe (Brazil/Forward)[/h3]
A forward specialized to be explosively powerful under certain conditions. Although it has short range and a hefty drop off, his Wild Shot is a top-tier, powerful shot.
What's more, his skill Master Blaster makes it even stronger. Shooting it at point-blank range would do some serious damage! And with his skill Hungry Striker, which stacks his power, his point-making prowess only grows later into games.

[h3]Taichi Nakanishi (Naniwa MS/Goalie)[/h3]
One of the country's foremost goalies, he has clear strengths and weaknesses. With his characteristic skill Naniwa Bigshot GK, the chance for Critical Goals gets higher, but his save power against every other shot drastically increases.
And with skills like Upgrades and Winner's Confidence, which grow stronger while in the lead, when they all start to work together, they more than make up for their cost.

[i]*DLC characters can be used in custom teams.
*They will also begin to appear as Friend Cards in Card Packs, and in EPISODE: NEW HERO's Select Appeal Groups.[/i]

[h2]Today, we added the [b]Hanawa MS Route[/b] to [b]EPISODE: NEW HERO[/b] as part of Free Updates - Round 3.[/h2]

It's available to everyone by updating to version 1.30. We hope you enjoy it!

At Hanawa MS, the Tachibana Bros, with their near-perfect coordination, all but shoulder the team's offense. They play using unique combinations to score.

With the Custom Player, who always looked up to their play style, joining their ranks, one can only imagine the kind of ideas that will emerge. The world is about to see what kind of shot this trio can dream up!

notes.title: Three new characters are coming to Captain Tsubasa this Spring!
notes.content:
[h2]Add Xiao Junguang, Pepe and Taichi Nakanishi to your dream team and make the team stronger![/h2]

[h3]⚽ Xiao Junguang[/h3]
The fearless counter shooter, came to the United States from China with his grandfather to watch the tournament. He is passionate about beating back his opponents' shots, and uses the Superspeed Kickback Cannon, a counter move that increases the power move of the shot by kicking the opponent's shot back!

[h3]⚽ Pepe[/h3]
A Brazilian boy who was brought up in a poor family and dreams to become a pro player to support his family, excels in left-foot skills and uses his special Wild Shot, which has outstanding base power.

[h3]⚽ Taichi Nakanishi[/h3]
Naniwa’s giant goalie and the captain of Naniwa MS who joined the league due to his participation in the national tournament, is a strong GK with both power and agility. He uses the Super Saving technique - his reflexes are unimaginable given his large size, and he reacts immediately to the opponent's shot!

notes.title: New free scenario is out now and three new characters are released today ⚽
notes.content:
[h2]The Nankatsu MS story arc without Tsubasa has finally been added![/h2]

[previewyoutube=RgLvyLIKr_I;full][/previewyoutube]

The training plan for Nankatsu is now in place! However, Tsubasa’s injury hasn’t helped things… Your mission is to help Nankatsu win all matches in the New Hero League with stand-in captain Ishizaki.

To win the league, he will use his bravery to lead the team! Ryo Ishizaki: Tsubasa’s best friend. They have fought together since their elementary school days.

Tsubasa Ozora: The one and only ace of the Nankatsu. Tsubasa has achieved V3 by winning many fierce matches in National middle school tournaments. However, he suffered an injury to his leg and left shoulder during the tournament.

[h3]⚽ Feature of [i]Nankatsu MS story arc[/i][/h3]
The new story arc in which Nankatsu competes against several prestigious schools without their injured captain Tsubasa. Ishizaki takes over as captain and leads Nankatsu MS. Tsubasa will join in the final!
 
[h3]⚽ Appeal Command [i]Tsubasa’s Passion[/i][/h3]
You can swap up to five players in your group. This move has better usage than “Misugi’s Analysis” but its usage count is lower. Because of the limited usage count, it is important to use it at the correct time.

You are a first grade student of Nankatsu MS, but Tsubasa and his teammates discovered your talent and you became one of the Eleven.

Communicate with other players by using Tsubasa’s Appeal Command! This command can switch five players among the appeal group. You can concentrate on increasing Friendship Rank.

Musashi Training Support Challenge is also starting today! Today’s other news is that Musashi MS Event Match is coming very soon!

[h3]⚽ [i]Musashi MS[/i] Training Support Campaign[/h3]
Ability Points will be easier to acquire in the Musashi Middle School story arc in “EPISODE OF NEW HERO” during the campaign, making it easier to develop stronger players.
This will be linked to the participation conditions of the following week’s event, so let’s take the opportunity to train a lot!

[i]Event Period：3/24 – 4/6 (TBD)[/i]
[i]*Dates may differ depending on each region’s time zone.[/i]

[h3]⚽ [i]Musashi MS[/i] Event Match[/h3]
You can play a match with a team that includes more than 8 characters from Musashi MS or edited players that trained at Musachi MS.
Event points depending on the event match victory/loss can be won, and a bonus is given each time a player surpasses the fixed point total. There is an event exclusive bonus, so be sure to obtain as many points as possible!

[i]Event Period：3/31 – 4/6 (TBD)[/i]
[i]*Dates may differ depending on each region’s time zone.[/i]
[i]Event Rewards:[/i]
[list]
[*] Musashi MS uniform for edited players
[*] Limited Emblem of Jun Misugi
[*] Limited Friend Card of Jun Misugi
[/list]
[b]Other schools coming soon![/b]


[h2]We are also celebrating the release of three new playable characters:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329554/Captain_Tsubasa_Rise_of_New_Champions__Mark_Owairan/]Mark Owairan[/url] [DF] the captain of the national Junior Youth team of Saudi Arabia, is an all-rounder mastering the Sandstorm Shot, a powerful long shot.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329555/Captain_Tsubasa_Rise_of_New_Champions__Shingo_Aoi/]Shingo Aoi[/url] [MF] a second-year junior high school student who adores Tsubasa. He's particularly fast and agile and can pull off neat overhead lifts and kicks.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329553/Captain_Tsubasa_Rise_of_New_Champions__Ryoma_Hino/]Ryoma Hino[/url] [F] a Japanese-Uruguayan player who wasn’t selected as a representative, but came to America to be inspired by the players from his generation. notes.content:
[h2]Update Information[/h2]

The following updates have been implemented:

[h3]⚽ Nankatsu MS Route[/h3]
The Nankatsu MS Route for EPISODE: NEW HERO is now available.

Never Give Up/Taunting Guardian

Fixed a bug where skills were unable to be acquired when using Skip Story with the Skip All setting.

We are celebrating the addition of the Nankatsu MS Route in Episode of New Hero by having an [i]"Nankatsu MS Inaugural Login Bonus"[/i] event after maintenance on Wednesday, March 10!

Remember, you can earn rewards once per day when you log into the game!

Following maintenance on Wed., March 10, 2021 until Tues., March 16, 2021 11:59 PM (UTC)

[i]*You can claim bonuses the 1st day after maintenance ends.

*Login Bonuses change every day at 12:00 AM (UTC).

Today, we added the Nankatsu MS Route to EPISODE: NEW HERO as part of Free Updates - Round 2.

It's available to everyone by updating to version 1.20.
We hope you enjoy it!

[h3]⚽ Features of Nankatsu MS Route[/h3]
Of course, Nankatsu MS is home to the incredible Tsubasa, who dishes out precise passes all while
looking for opportunities of his own. However, for this route Tsubasa is recovering from his

notes.title: DLC 4, 5 and 6 will be out this spring!
notes.content:
[h2]Let’s meet the new upcoming characters! You can also find details of their skills![/h2]

Two Japanese players and a Saudi prince will soon be joining the game! The new characters will be Aoi and Hino, whose talents are equal to that of the Japanese National Team, and Owairan, a man of royal blood.

All of them appeared in the World Youth story arc. Let’s add them to your dream team and make your team stronger!


[h2]Mark Owairan[/h2]
Captain of the national Junior Youth team of Saudi Arabia. He is called a “prince” as royal blood flows in his veins.

He’s an above average player with a high skill level. Although he is a DF, he also has good offensive ability.

[b]⚽ Sandstorm Shot:[/b] It is a long ranged shot with only a moderate drop in power, so you can use it from distance.

[b]⚽ Mirage Chapeau:[/b] This is an astonishing dribble move that feints a loss of footing. His offensive value and technique values will increase massively when the skill succeeds! 


[h2]Shingo Aoi[/h2]
A second-year junior high school student who adores Tsubasa. He is always cheerful and never gives up.

A MF who specialises in speed. He has a skill that allows him to accelerate every time he passes by an opponent, and when he gains momentum, his mobility is unstoppable!

[b]⚽ Overhead Lift:[/b] This skill lifts the ball past opponents and is followed by a powerful jump.  

[b]⚽ Rovesciata:[/b] This is an overhead kick with one of the highest power and speed ratings amongst all aerial shots.


[h2]Ryoma Hino[/h2]
A Japanese-Uruguayan player who wasn’t selected as a representative, but came to America to be inspired by the players from his generation.

His skill move makes use of his power and skill, and activates in the early stage of the game. Once activated, his aggressive attacks will never stop!

[b]⚽ Jumping Knee: [/b]This is a Power S dribble which can increase his offense value, and depending on the effect, can also increase his shot power.

[b]⚽ Dragon Shot:[/b] This is a surefire shot with dragon aura. Its power is equal to Tiger Shot!

notes.title: Latest updates and maintenance
notes.content:
[h1]New Updates[/h1]

[h2]Division Match Changeover[/h2]

Division Matches has entered a new season.
Ratings for your league have also been reset along with the new season changeover.

* After the reset, ratings for your respective league will be as follows. Rookie League: 0, Bronze League: 150, Silver League: 300, Gold League: 1000.

[h2]Season Rewards Distribution[/h2]

Season Rewards have been distributed based on your previous season's league.

Rewards will be claimed when you access the Division Match Menu.

* Only players who played at least one division match will receive rewards.

[h2]Measures against illegal activity[/h2]

Action has been taken against players who have committed illegal activity in division matches.

[h1]Regarding Illegal Activity[/h1]

We have taken action against user accounts who have been confirmed to violate article 12 of the EULA.

[u]Punishable Actions:[/u]
Purposefully disconnecting from the network and unfairly manipulating their rating in Division Matches.

[u]Actions Taken:[/u]
7 Day Log-in Freeze
Reset Rating to default

* Frozen accounts cannot access division matches, login bonuses, online challenges, nor the CC Shop.

[h1]Regarding Cheating Actions[/h1]

We have taken action against user accounts who have been confirmed to violate article 12 of the EULA.

[u]Punishable Actions:[/u]
Illegal manipulation of character stats, skills, and moves.

[u]Actions Taken:[/u]
Permanent Ban

* Banned accounts cannot access division matches, login bonuses, online challenges, the CC Shop, nor any future updates and online content.

[h1]Issues on Weekly Challenges
[/h1]
We have confirmed that some of the Weekly Challenges cannot be cleared even when all the conditions are met.

Currently, we have performed fixes so that the affected challenges do not occur. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

As an apology, we will distribute CC to players who log in during the distribution period.
[u]Items:[/u]
100 CC

[u]Distribution Period:[/u]
Following maintenance on Wednesday, November 4th, 2020 until 11:59 PM (UTC) Tuesday, November 17th, 2020

*Items will be distributed as login bonuses.
*Items can be accepted one time during the above distribution period.

Once again, we deeply apologize for the inconvenience. We hope you continue to enjoy Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions.

[h1]New Division Match Season Login Bonus
[/h1]
We are hosting a "New Division Match Season Login Bonus" alongside maintenance! You can earn rewards once per day when you log into the game, so don't forget to do so!
[u]
Event Period:[/u]
Following maintenance on Wednesday, November 4th, 2020 UTC until 11:59 PM (UTC) Tuesday, November 17th, 2020

*You can claim bonuses on the first day after maintenance ends.
*Please note the time to get it will be shorter.

*Login Bonuses switch over every day at 12:00 AM (UTC).
*Claim up to 10 login bonuses during the event period.
*Login bonus details may change without prior notice. Thank you for understanding.
